doc: One rule, two probes (ANCHOR_DUAL_STACK_PLAN.md, defect 3). Each case is what one diagnostic probe connection reported before its deadline, in order, and the verdict: `answered` (a STUN response came back), `unanswered` (the probe ran and nothing came back) or `notRun` (the engine failed the connection before gathering a single candidate, so nothing was sent). Read by leaf/tests/stun_probe_parity.rs (Rust: probe_verdict) and browser-ts/test/classification.test.ts (TypeScript: stunProbeVerdict). A case that one side answers differently fails that side's test.

cases.name: a server-reflexive candidate is an answer

events.candidate: candidate:1 1 udp 1686052607 203.0.113.9 50000 typ srflx raddr 0.0.0.0 rport 0

cases.name: a reflexive candidate at the end of the line is still one
an mDNS host candidate proves nothing
a relay candidate is not a STUN answer from this endpoint

events.candidate: candidate:4 1 udp 41885439 198.51.100.4 3478 typ relay raddr 203.0.113.9 rport 50000

cases.name: a STUN error response is an answer (401)
Chromium's STUN error number is an answer
no response, then a reflexive candidate: answered

events.candidate: candidate:1 1 udp 1686052607 203.0.113.9 50000 typ srflx raddr 0.0.0.0 rport 0

cases.name: a word that merely contains srflx is not the type

events.candidate: candidate:5 1 udp 2122260223 192.168.1.2 50001 typ host ufrag nosrflx

cases.name: an engine that gathered nothing and failed the connection did not run
a host candidate then a failed connection: it ran, and nothing answered
an answer before the failure still counts
